customer: I'm trying to sell my electric car to you before the baby's due, and of course I can't find the title anywhere in this sleep-deprived chaos. Do I seriously have to start over, or is there a way to keep this moving? I'm in North Carolina and really don't have time for a runaround.
agent: I'm sorry you're dealing with this on top of everything else, and you won't have to start over. Per our article "Getting a duplicate title in North Carolina," you can request a duplicate by mail or at any North Carolina motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID. It takes 4 to 6 weeks to arrive, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers last a limited time, so you may need a new one; see "How long is my offer good for?" for details.
